turns.user: What actions and deadlines does the environmental and social commitment plan set for P170132?

expected_sources.role: Latest ESCP (for negotiations, June 2025), which supersedes earlier versions

text: Source: the Additional Financing ESCP for P170132 ('For Negotiations', June 2025; record dated 2025-06-13). It supersedes earlier ESCPs and covers both the original and additional financing (p. 2). Responsible: Pamir Energy Company (PEC) in GBAO and Shabakahoi Taqsimoti Barq (STB) with ESPMU in Khatlon.

Organization and reporting: keep the existing E&S staff and structure (A); train PEC and STB E&S staff and contractors throughout (B) (p. 3); quarterly E&S reports within 30 days of each period and contractors' monthly reports (C-D, p. 4); notify incidents within 24 hours (E, p. 5).

Assessment: PEC to update the ESIA and finish the ESMP for the new 110 kV substation in GBAO, approved and disclosed, before the effective date (target July 2025) and before construction (1.1, p. 5); the ESIA/ESMP for the associated Sebzor HPP and Khorog line was disclosed before bidding in 2020 (1.2); screening of sub-projects with Bank prior review of the first two under each ESMF (1.4); update the SEP before construction (1.5.1); permits throughout (1.6) (pp. 5-6).

Labour: update the labour management procedures, including worker camps, before construction (June 2025); workers' grievance mechanism in place since April 2019; OHS plan for the new substation before construction (July 2025); emergency preparedness in place since 2019; worker training as works start (2.1-2.5, pp. 6-7).

Community and land: waste and battery disposal per ESIAs/ESMFs (3.1, p. 8); traffic safety and an updated community health and safety plan before construction (July 2025) (4.1-4.2, p. 8); community awareness throughout (4.5, p. 9); no resettlement expected because PEC already owns 2 ha at the 35 kV station, but a due-diligence report confirming the land is free of squatters before construction (June 2025) (5.2, p. 9); biodiversity management plan used throughout (6.1, p. 10); chance-finds procedure (8.1, p. 10); SEP disclosed before construction (10.1) and grievance mechanism reported quarterly (10.2, p. 11).

Caveats: most dated actions fall in June-July 2025, before the AF became effective (21 November 2025, per the June 2026 ISR), so they should now be complete; the SEP deadline is printed as 'June 2015' (p. 11), an evident typo for 2025; several actions still name Barqi Tojik, which no longer implements the Khatlon part.

right_sources: Uses the latest ESCP (40021640, 2025) or says which version it used.
grounded: Actions, responsible entities and deadlines match the ESCP items with pages; the 'June 2015' typo is not presented as a real date.
complete: Covers the main action groups (organization, reporting, assessment, labour/OHS, community, land, biodiversity, stakeholder engagement) with their deadlines.
scoped: Names the ESCP version and notes that dated deadlines have passed and their status is not reported in the ESCP.

notes: A revised ESCP would supersede this one.
